title: Calls for Police Investigation After Patient Deaths at Scottish Hospital
subtitle: A senior surgeon claims that avoidable surgical errors led to the deaths of at least 19 patients, sparking a heated debate over hospital accountability.

summary.en: A senior surgeon at Aberdeen Royal Infirmary has requested a criminal investigation into patient deaths. An internal report confirmed 19 people died from surgical complications between 2015 and 2021. The hospital board is now facing intense pressure to explain these safety failures. Scotland’s First Minister has called the situation a matter of the gravest concern. However, the government has rejected immediate calls for a formal police investigation into the hospital.
summary.zh: 亞伯丁皇家醫院的一名資深外科醫師要求對病患死亡事件進行刑事調查。一份內部報告證實，二零一五年至二零二一年間，有十九人因手術併發症死亡。醫院委員會目前面臨解釋這些安全疏失的巨大壓力。蘇格蘭首席大臣稱此情況極度令人擔憂。然而，政府已拒絕立即對該醫院進行正式的警方調查。

paragraphs.en: A senior surgeon at Aberdeen Royal Infirmary has called for a police investigation into the hospital following reports that at least 19 patients died due to preventable surgical complications. Dr. Mohammed Habib, a consultant at the hospital, claims he repeatedly raised concerns about liver and pancreatic surgery standards starting in 2021. He believes that many of these deaths were entirely unnecessary and could have been avoided if the hospital had listened to his warnings sooner.
paragraphs.zh: 亞伯丁皇家醫院 (Aberdeen Royal Infirmary) 的一名資深外科醫師呼籲警方對該院展開調查，此前有報導指出，至少有十九名病患因可預防的手術併發症而死亡。該院顧問醫師穆罕默德·哈比卜 (Mohammed Habib) 聲稱，他自二零二一年起便多次針對肝臟與胰臟手術的醫療水準提出疑慮。他認為，這些死亡案例中有許多完全是不必要的，若醫院能更早聽取他的警告，這些悲劇本可避免。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian Health, Dr. Habib is now asking for a criminal investigation into what he calls "corporate homicide." This term describes a situation where an organization is responsible for a death because of serious management failures. Dr. Habib alleges that senior officials at NHS Grampian, the health board responsible for the hospital, failed to take necessary action when the problems were first reported. The NHS is the publicly funded healthcare system in the United Kingdom, and it has a legal duty to provide the best possible care to all patients.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報健康版》(The Guardian Health) 報導，哈比卜醫師目前正要求針對他所謂的「企業殺人」進行刑事調查。此術語用以描述組織因嚴重的管理疏失而導致死亡的情況。哈比卜醫師指控，負責該醫院的格蘭扁國家醫療服務體系 (NHS Grampian) 的高層官員，在問題首次被通報時未能採取必要行動。國家醫療服務體系是英國的公費醫療系統，該體系負有法律義務，必須為所有病患提供最佳的照護。

paragraphs.en: An internal report, which was recently made public by Dr. Habib’s lawyer, confirms that 19 patients died due to "serious adverse events" linked to surgery between 2015 and 2021. Experts who reviewed the data found that the death rate for these specific surgeries at the hospital was as high as 18 percent between 2017 and 2020. This is significantly higher than the national average, which usually sits between 2 and 3 percent for the same type of procedures. Dr. Habib also reported that four additional patients have died during or after surgery since that initial report was completed.
paragraphs.zh: 一份由哈比卜醫師的律師近期公開的內部報告證實，二零一五年至二零二一年間，有十九名病患因與手術相關的「嚴重不良事件」而死亡。審閱該數據的專家發現，二零一七年至二零二零年間，該院進行此類特定手術的死亡率高達百分之十八。這遠高於同類手術通常介於百分之二至百分之三的全國平均水準。哈比卜醫師並指出，自該份初步報告完成後，又有四名病患在手術期間或術後死亡。

paragraphs.en: The situation has become a major topic of discussion in the Scottish Parliament. John Swinney, Scotland’s First Minister, described the disclosures made by Dr. Habib as "of the gravest concern." He emphasized that the NHS must investigate safety failures quickly and transparently. However, the government has so far refused to launch a criminal investigation. Instead, Mr. Swinney argued that the current plan to change the leadership and force urgent reforms at the health board will lead to the necessary improvements. This response has faced criticism from opposition leaders, such as Michael Marra, the Scottish Labour leader, who stated that the families of the victims deserve justice and clear answers.
paragraphs.zh: 此情況已成為蘇格蘭議會討論的主要議題。蘇格蘭首席大臣約翰·史溫尼 (John Swinney) 將哈比卜醫師揭露的資訊形容為「極度令人擔憂」。他強調，國家醫療服務體系必須迅速且透明地調查安全疏失。然而，政府目前拒絕啟動刑事調查。史溫尼主張，目前更換領導層並強制該醫療委員會進行緊急改革的計畫，將能帶來必要的改善。此回應遭到反對黨領袖批評，例如蘇格蘭工黨領袖麥可·馬拉 (Michael Marra) 表示，受害者家屬理應獲得正義與明確的答案。

paragraphs.en: In response to these serious allegations, Laura Skaife-Knight, the chief executive of NHS Grampian, stated that the hospital is aware of the concerns. She noted that a thorough investigation has already taken place, though some parts of that work are still ongoing. She promised that any new evidence will be carefully considered. According to The Guardian Health, the hospital board maintains that it follows strict "duty of candour" processes. This is a legal requirement for healthcare organizations to be open and honest with patients and their families when something goes wrong during their care.
paragraphs.zh: 針對這些嚴重的指控，格蘭扁國家醫療服務體系的執行長蘿拉·斯凱夫-奈特 (Laura Skaife-Knight) 表示，醫院已注意到這些疑慮。她指出，院方已進行徹底調查，儘管部分工作仍在進行中。她承諾將審慎考量任何新證據。根據《衛報健康版》報導，醫院委員會堅稱其遵循嚴格的「坦誠義務」程序。這是一項法律要求，規定醫療機構在照護過程中發生差錯時，必須對病患及其家屬保持公開與誠實。

paragraphs.en: This latest scandal adds to a growing list of challenges for the NHS. As reported in recent updates, the health service is currently dealing with several other major issues, including concerns over patient data privacy and a separate case where cancer patients received years of unnecessary chemotherapy due to poor medical oversight. These events have created a difficult environment for the health service, as public trust is tested by repeated reports of systemic failures.
paragraphs.zh: 這起最新醜聞增加了國家醫療服務體系面臨的挑戰清單。正如近期更新的報導所述，該醫療服務體系目前正處理其他幾項重大議題，包括對病患資料隱私的擔憂，以及另一宗癌症病患因醫療監督不周，而接受多年不必要化療的案件。這些事件為醫療服務體系創造了艱困的環境，因為大眾對系統性疏失的重複報導，正考驗著公眾的信任。

paragraphs.en: Looking ahead, the pressure on NHS Grampian remains high. In March 2026, an external expert warned hospital executives that the persistent high mortality rate in complex surgeries was a "red flag" and suggested that these operations should stop. Despite these warnings, the unit has continued to perform surgeries. As the debate continues, the focus remains on whether current management changes will be enough to ensure patient safety or if a more formal, legal intervention will be required to hold those responsible to account. For now, the hospital says that patient safety remains its highest priority, but for the families of the 19 patients who died, the road to finding answers is far from over.
paragraphs.zh: 展望未來，格蘭扁國家醫療服務體系所承受的壓力依然巨大。二零二六年三月，一位外部專家曾警告醫院高層，複雜手術中持續偏高的死亡率是一個「危險訊號」，並建議應停止這些手術。儘管有這些警告，該單位仍持續進行手術。隨著辯論持續進行，焦點仍放在目前的管理層變動是否足以確保病患安全，或者是否需要更正式的法律介入，以追究相關責任人的責任。目前，醫院表示病患安全仍是其最高優先事項，但對於那十九名死亡病患的家屬而言，尋求真相之路仍遙遙無期。

keyTerms.definitionEn: To bring a topic or concern to someone's attention for discussion.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 提出（問題、疑慮等）以供討論。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「舉起」或「增加」，這裡指提出意見或擔憂。文中：Dr. Mohammed Habib, a consultant at the hospital, claims he repeatedly raised concerns about liver and pancreatic surgery standards starting in 2021.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To be at a particular level or value.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「坐下」，這裡指數據或比例處於某個範圍。文中：This is significantly higher than the national average, which usually sits between 2 and 3 percent for the same type of procedures.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Responsibility for one's actions or decisions.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「帳戶」，這裡在片語 hold someone to account 中指要求某人對其行為負責。文中：As the debate continues, the focus remains on whether current management changes will be enough to ensure patient safety or if a more formal, legal intervention will be required to hold those responsible to account.

quiz.question: According to the internal report mentioned in the article, what was the mortality rate for specific surgeries at Aberdeen Royal Infirmary between 2017 and 2020?

options.D: Significantly lower than the national average

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段，專家審查數據後發現該醫院在 2017 到 2020 年間，特定手術的死亡率高達 18%。選項 A 是全國平均值，而非該醫院的數據；選項 C 的 19 是指死亡病患的總人數，而非死亡率；選項 D 與文意完全相反，該醫院的死亡率遠高於全國平均。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the relationship between the hospital's management and the warnings they received?

options.A: The management immediately shut down the surgical unit after the 2026 warning.
options.B: The management was unaware of the high mortality rates until Dr. Habib spoke to the press.
options.C: The management continued to operate despite being advised by experts to stop.
options.D: The management prioritized legal advice over the safety of the patients.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章倒數第二段，外部專家在 2026 年 3 月曾警告高死亡率是「危險信號」，並建議停止手術，但醫院單位仍持續進行手術。選項 A 與文意矛盾；選項 B 不正確，因為文章提到醫院已收到警告；選項 D 文中未提及管理層優先考慮法律建議，僅提到他們面臨管理改革的壓力。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the phrase 'duty of candour' imply regarding the hospital's responsibilities?

options.A: The obligation to be transparent and honest about medical errors.
options.B: The requirement to provide financial compensation to the families of victims.
options.C: The duty to perform only the most complex and necessary surgeries.
options.D: The legal right to keep internal investigations private from the public.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文章第五段解釋了 'duty of candour' 是醫療組織在發生醫療疏失時，必須對病患及其家屬保持公開與誠實的法律要求。選項 B 文中未提及賠償；選項 C 與此詞彙定義無關；選項 D 則與 'open and honest' 的定義完全相反，故不正確。

quiz.question: What is the central focus of the article?

options.A: A detailed history of the NHS healthcare system in the United Kingdom.
options.B: The success of new management reforms at NHS Grampian.
options.C: The ongoing controversy and calls for accountability regarding preventable deaths at Aberdeen Royal Infirmary.
options.D: A comparison between liver surgery standards in Scotland and other countries.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。本文主要討論 Aberdeen Royal Infirmary 因手術死亡率過高而引發的爭議，以及 Dr. Habib 對醫院管理層的指控與各界對此事件的反應。選項 A 過於廣泛，本文僅聚焦於單一醫院；選項 B 與現實不符，因為改革尚未被證明成功；選項 D 並非文章主旨，文中僅提到該醫院的手術表現，並未與其他國家進行比較。
